"''Blik. Get away from them. We told you to stay away from street rats.|Blik and its mother about Cad Bane and Niro|audio=StreetRats.mp3|}} '''Blik''' was a [[Duros]] [[youngling]]. At some point between c. [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]],{{TalesDate|U4}} it was strolling the streets of a [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|bustling city]] with its [[Blik's mother|mother]] and another [[Blik's parent|parent]] when he came across the Duros [[Gender|boys]] [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]]. Seeing as one of them banged on a roadside machine and the other penetrated a trashcan, Blik asked what they were doing, only for its parents to come around and scotch the conversation. Blik's [[Parent|mother]] instructed it to get away from the younglings because he had been told to eschew street [[rat]]s. Soon, the family moved on, leaving Colby and Niro behind. While his parents led him away, Blik turned back to take one last look at his peers, receiving a rushing pat on its shoulder from its mother as it walked. A [[Color|red]]-[[eye]]d Duros youngling, Blik had light-blue skin with a dark-blue patch atop its [[hair]]less head. It sported a dark-olive, high-collared [[Clothing|top]] beneath a sleeveless, beige-and-brown shirt with a crisscross pattern on the chest area. In addition, it wore a pair of brown pants, its backside partially covered by a roughly oval pad protruding from the top. ==Behind the scenes== Blik first appeared in the "[[The Good Life]]," an episode of the animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which was released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} The character was voiced by [[David W.
